contact.whyChooseRenoStarsTitle: Why Choose Reno Stars for Your Renovation
contact.whyChooseRenoStarsP1: With over a decade of hands-on experience in Metro Vancouver, Reno Stars has built a reputation for delivering renovation projects that exceed expectations. Our team of licensed tradespeople, project managers, and designers work together under one roof to ensure every detail — from structural changes to finishing touches — is executed with precision and care. We are fully insured with $5M CGL coverage and maintain active WCB registration for all our workers, so you can have complete peace of mind throughout your project.
contact.whyChooseRenoStarsP2: As a locally owned and operated company, we understand the unique challenges of renovating in the Lower Mainland — from older homes with aging infrastructure to modern condos requiring careful trade coordination. We have completed hundreds of projects across diverse neighbourhoods and property types, giving us deep knowledge of local building codes, permit requirements, and the specific expectations of Vancouver-area homeowners. Our up to 3-year workmanship warranty on labour is our commitment to quality that stands the test of time.
contact.whyChooseRenoStarsP3: Communication is the foundation of every successful renovation. When you work with Reno Stars, you receive a dedicated project manager who serves as your single point of contact from the initial consultation through to final handover. No confusion, no misdirected questions, no surprises — just a clear, transparent process designed to make your renovation experience as smooth and stress-free as possible.
contact.renovationProcessIntro: We've refined our workflow into five clear, manageable steps so you always know what to expect. From your first phone call or inquiry to the moment we hand over your completed renovation, every phase is designed to keep you informed and in control.
contact.processStep1Desc: Every project begins with a conversation. Reach us by phone, email, WhatsApp, WeChat, or SMS — whatever is most convenient for you. During this free consultation, we discuss your renovation goals, style preferences, budget expectations, and timeline. We gather any existing floor plans or site photos you may have and answer your initial questions about the process.
contact.processStep2Desc: For most projects, we schedule an on-site visit to take precise measurements and assess the existing conditions of your space. We then prepare a comprehensive design proposal that illustrates your future space, along with a clearly defined scope of work, project timeline, permit requirements, and material specifications. You receive a transparent, detailed quotation — no hidden fees, no surprises.
contact.processStep3Desc: We invite you to our showroom to review material samples firsthand — cabinetry finishes, countertop options, flooring, and more. We finalize all design details, confirm your selections, and establish a payment schedule that works for your project. Once everything is confirmed, we sign the construction contract and collect the deposit to secure your start date.
contact.processStep4Desc: Your dedicated project manager takes over full coordination of all trades and on-site work. You never need to interact directly with workers or juggle multiple contractors — we handle it all. We provide regular progress updates, coordinate all material deliveries, and maintain strict quality control at every stage. Any issues that arise are resolved quickly and efficiently, keeping your project on schedule.
contact.processStep5Desc: Once construction is complete, we conduct a thorough final walkthrough with you to confirm every detail meets your expectations. We walk through the completed work, demonstrate how to operate any new systems or fixtures, and address any final questions. Your project is covered by our workmanship warranty, and our team remains available for ongoing support after handover.
contact.serviceAreasIntro: Reno Stars proudly serves homeowners and businesses throughout the Lower Mainland and surrounding communities. Whether you're in the heart of Vancouver or the surrounding neighbourhoods, our experienced team is ready to bring your renovation vision to life.
contact.serviceAreasList: Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Surrey, Delta, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Langley, White Rock, New Westminster, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Port Moody, and surrounding Metro Vancouver communities.
contact.faqQ1: How do I get started with a renovation estimate?
contact.faqA1: Simply reach out via phone, email, WhatsApp, WeChat, or SMS — or fill out the contact form on this page. We respond to all inquiries within 24 hours and can typically schedule an initial consultation within a few days of your first contact.
contact.faqA2: Yes — we offer a free, no-obligation initial consultation. For more detailed project quotes, we conduct an on-site assessment and provide a comprehensive written quotation that includes scope of work, timeline, and transparent pricing.
contact.faqA3: Absolutely. Reno Stars carries $5M CGL (commercial general liability) insurance and maintains active WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) coverage for all workers. We are a licensed renovation contractor in British Columbia, and we handle all required building permits for your project.
contact.faqQ4: Do you provide warranties on your work?
contact.faqA4: Yes. We back every project with our workmanship warranty of up to 3 years on labour. We also ensure all materials and installed products carry their respective manufacturer warranties. Full warranty details are provided in your construction contract.
